units.function: the concern is phrased as attention fastening onto a named thing

original_instantiations: growing influence is said to have drawn considerable attention onto the fragile country
the attention is attached to the thing, not paid by anyone named

units.source_excerpt: with the rapid increase of the climate change influence, considerable attention has been attached to the so called fragile country
units.reusable_pattern: open by saying attention has fastened on the subject
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse attached attention for every topic

units.rhetorical_move: names the model for the sake of measurement
units.function: a model is introduced by the measurement it makes possible

original_instantiations: numeric measurement is given as the reason for introducing two quantities
the two quantities are said to make up the index

units.source_excerpt: for the sake of numeric measurement of the influence, we introduce the anomaly and the extreme weather probability, which make up the index
units.reusable_pattern: introduce a quantity by the measurement it serves
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim a quantity measures what it does not

units.rhetorical_move: lets a conclusion arrive by itself
units.function: a result is phrased as something that comes to the authors

original_instantiations: the coupling model is built and then the conclusion is said to come to the authors
the fragility is said to rise correspondingly

units.source_excerpt: we establish the coupling model, thus it comes to us that the fragility rises up correspondingly
units.reusable_pattern: present a conclusion as arriving on its own
prohibited_generalizations: do not let a conclusion arrive without the work behind it

units.function: a threshold is followed by a call to stay watchful

original_instantiations: reaching the stated line makes a country fragile, and the other indexes carry their own warning
the warning verb is should be vigilant

units.source_excerpt: a country reaches the tipping point when the index drops to the stated value, and when the other indexes reach their own critical points it should also be vigilant
units.reusable_pattern: follow a threshold with a call to stay watchful
prohibited_generalizations: do not add a warning the paper does not give

units.rhetorical_move: claims wide reach in two adjectives
units.function: applicability is asserted as a pair of qualities

original_instantiations: changing the indicators is said to leave the models highly stable and widely applicable
the claim is two adjectives joined

units.source_excerpt: with the appropriate alteration of indicators, our models have high stability and extensive applicability
units.reusable_pattern: claim portability as a pair of qualities
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim wide applicability from one alteration

units.rhetorical_move: opens with when it comes to
units.function: the topic is entered through a stock opener

original_instantiations: the climate topic is opened with a stock phrase and then justified by people valuing its impacts
the valuation verb is think more highly of

units.source_excerpt: when it comes to climate change, many studies can be referred to since people think more highly of its impacts
units.reusable_pattern: enter a topic with a stock opener and a reason
prohibited_generalizations: do not open every section the same way

units.function: a definition is borrowed and attributed

original_instantiations: a named report is cited and then the definition is given in its words
the reasons are listed after the definition

units.source_excerpt: according to the assessment report, climate change refers to the changes in climate state
units.reusable_pattern: borrow a definition from a named authority
prohibited_generalizations: do not attribute a definition to a source that lacks it

units.function: a causal claim is closed by a certainty word

original_instantiations: poor governance joined with environmental instability is said to trigger conflict, and the claim is sealed with a certainty word
the certainty word carries no evidence

units.source_excerpt: correlating with poor governance and social fragmentation, environmental instability will trigger violent conflict undoubtedly
units.reusable_pattern: seal a causal claim with a certainty word
prohibited_generalizations: do not use a certainty word where the evidence is thin

units.rhetorical_move: states the plan as a bulleted route
units.function: the work is previewed as a sequence of moves

original_instantiations: the problems are to be tackled by a stated sequence of steps
each step is one bullet

units.source_excerpt: we will proceed as follows for the sake of tackling these problems
units.reusable_pattern: preview the work as a numbered route
prohibited_generalizations: do not preview steps the paper never takes

units.rhetorical_move: says human activity can do a favor
units.function: intervention is phrased as a favor

original_instantiations: human activity is said to do a favor by keeping a country from growing more delicate
the benefit is tied to the model's results

units.source_excerpt: human activities can do a favor to prevent a country becoming more delicate, which can be predicted from the results of our model
units.reusable_pattern: describe an intervention as doing a favor
prohibited_generalizations: do not soften a policy into a favor

units.function: the assumption list is introduced with a guarantee

original_instantiations: the hypotheses are made to simplify the problem and each one is promised a justification
the guarantee comes before any assumption

units.source_excerpt: to simplify the given problems and modify them for real conditions, we make the following basic hypotheses, each of which is properly justified
units.reusable_pattern: promise a justification for every assumption
prohibited_generalizations: do not promise a justification the text never gives

units.function: an assumption narrows the sample and says so

original_instantiations: every country is assumed to respond and act, and the countries that do not are set aside in the same sentence
the exclusion is named

units.source_excerpt: we assume that all the countries react positively and take interventions, neglecting the passive countries
units.reusable_pattern: state an assumption together with what it leaves out
prohibited_generalizations: do not hide an exclusion inside an assumption

units.function: the symbols are handed to a table

original_instantiations: the reader is sent to a table for the symbols
no symbol is defined in the sentence

units.source_excerpt: we list the symbols and notations used in this paper in the table
units.reusable_pattern: hand the notation to a table
prohibited_generalizations: do not leave a symbol undefined in both prose and table

units.function: a long definition is quoted through an organization

original_instantiations: an organization is cited for the conditions under which a country counts as fragile
the definition is one long conditional

units.source_excerpt: the organization assumes that a country lacking political ability or political will is considered a fragile country
units.reusable_pattern: borrow a definition as a long conditional
prohibited_generalizations: do not shorten a quoted definition into a different one

units.rhetorical_move: grounds a window in an authority
units.function: a statistical convention is cited to justify a time window

original_instantiations: a meteorological organization is cited for the thirty year window that represents a climate
the window is then used as the baseline

units.source_excerpt: recalling on the basic knowledge of meteorology, the organization stipulates that thirty years of statistical mean can represent the native climate
units.reusable_pattern: justify a time window by an authority's stipulation
prohibited_generalizations: do not invent a window length

units.rhetorical_move: explains a curve shape by a disturbance
units.function: a functional form is justified by how common the cause is

original_instantiations: a small anomaly is called reasonable and common, so the function is said to rise exponentially
a critical value is set at the end of the piece

units.source_excerpt: the anomaly changing within a standard deviation is reasonable and common because of the micro disturbance, thus the function obeys an exponential distribution
units.reusable_pattern: justify a curve shape by the commonness of its cause
prohibited_generalizations: do not call a chosen shape a distribution

units.function: a function is narrated as it changes shape

original_instantiations: the rise is said to slow from a linear shape to a logarithmic one, with a critical value at each change
the narration ends by promising the formula

units.source_excerpt: with the increasing value of the anomaly, the speed will slow down gradually, from the linear shape to the logarithmic distribution
units.reusable_pattern: narrate a piecewise function as a slowing
prohibited_generalizations: do not narrate a shape the formula lacks

units.function: a figure is introduced with a stock intensifier

original_instantiations: the figure is said to show vividly that extreme disasters are high temperature and rainstorm
the intensifier adds nothing

units.source_excerpt: as is vividly shown in the figure, the extreme weather disasters mainly embody in high temperature and rainstorm
units.reusable_pattern: introduce a figure with an intensifier
prohibited_generalizations: do not add vividly where the figure is plain

units.function: equal weights are confessed as a difficulty

original_instantiations: measuring the real shares is called difficult, so the factors are assumed equally crucial
the assumption is stated as a consequence of the difficulty

units.source_excerpt: it is difficult for us to measure the actual proportion of those factors, hence we assume that they are as crucial as each other
units.reusable_pattern: justify equal weights by the difficulty of measuring them
prohibited_generalizations: do not hide an equal-weight assumption as a finding

units.rhetorical_move: reads an indicator as inversely proportional
units.function: an indicator's direction is stated as a proportion

original_instantiations: food production is chosen to stand for agriculture, and its value is said to run inversely with fragility
the direction is given in one clause

units.source_excerpt: we choose food production to represent the agriculture's reflection on climate change, and the value of this indicator is inversely proportional to the fragility
units.reusable_pattern: state an indicator's direction as a proportion
prohibited_generalizations: do not reverse a direction

units.function: a relationship is called common knowledge

original_instantiations: emissions and climate are said to interact, and this is offered as common knowledge before the indicator is chosen
the concession does the justifying

units.source_excerpt: as we all know, greenhouse gas emissions and climate change interact with each other, therefore we take emissions per capita as an indicator
units.reusable_pattern: justify an indicator by calling its link common knowledge
prohibited_generalizations: do not call a disputed link common knowledge

units.function: a method is brought back rather than introduced

original_instantiations: the weighting method is recalled and the standardization is announced as the next step
the recall implies the method is already known

units.source_excerpt: recalling on the entropy weight method, we will carry out the standardized treatment
units.reusable_pattern: bring in a method by recalling it
prohibited_generalizations: do not recall a method the reader has not met

units.rhetorical_move: praises a method for having no impression
units.function: objectivity is claimed as the absence of a personal impression

original_instantiations: the variation method is said to give each weight without any subjective impression
the virtue is stated as an absence

units.source_excerpt: by this way, we are able to achieve the weight of each index without any subjective impression
units.reusable_pattern: claim objectivity as the absence of personal impression
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim objectivity for a method with hidden choices

units.function: a calculation is omitted because it is standard

original_instantiations: a distance is used to sort the countries and the calculation is skipped as conventional
the omission is stated openly

units.source_excerpt: we use the distance to clarify these countries into four groups, and since it is a conventional method we neglect the calculation
units.reusable_pattern: omit a calculation by calling it conventional
prohibited_generalizations: do not skip a calculation the result depends on

units.rhetorical_move: states the direction of the score
units.function: the meaning of a high score is fixed in one sentence

original_instantiations: a higher value is said to mean a more fragile country
the direction is fixed before the results

units.source_excerpt: the higher the value is, the more fragile the country is
units.reusable_pattern: fix the direction of a score in one comparative
prohibited_generalizations: do not leave the direction of a score implicit

units.rhetorical_move: matches the result to a known ranking
units.function: agreement with a published ranking is asserted

original_instantiations: the published ranks are said to match the new index well
the verdict is the word well

units.source_excerpt: the original fragility ranks match the fragile index we established well
units.reusable_pattern: claim agreement with a published ranking
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim a match the figure does not show

units.rhetorical_move: explains a label by a country's character
units.function: a classification is justified by what the country is

original_instantiations: a developed country's power, infrastructure and technology are said to make it impregnable
the label follows the character

units.source_excerpt: its global superpower, firm infrastructure and advanced technology determine that it will be easier to deal with climate change, thus it is clarified as impregnable
units.reusable_pattern: justify a label by the country's character
prohibited_generalizations: do not infer a label from reputation

units.rhetorical_move: lets a table come to the authors
units.function: a reading of a table is phrased as an arrival

original_instantiations: the correlation table is said to make the relevance come to the authors clearly
the arrival phrase replaces a verb of finding

units.source_excerpt: in the table, it comes to us clearly that the two indexes show great relevance
units.reusable_pattern: present a table reading as something that arrives
prohibited_generalizations: do not let a result arrive without the table

units.rhetorical_move: explains a weak link as slow and hidden
units.function: a small coefficient is given a reason

original_instantiations: the social coefficients are smaller and the influence is called slow and hidden
the reason is that the effect needs time

units.source_excerpt: the coefficients on the social side are smaller, because the influence is slow and hidden and needs time to reveal
units.reusable_pattern: explain a weak coefficient by delay
prohibited_generalizations: do not explain a number by an unmeasured delay

units.function: a near zero link is not allowed to be nothing

original_instantiations: the political link is called very small and then a residual effect is insisted on
the residual is called potential

units.source_excerpt: the coefficients are very little, but that does not mean there is no effect, and the climate change still has potential influence
units.reusable_pattern: refuse to read a small coefficient as no effect
prohibited_generalizations: do not invent a residual effect

units.function: a line is described as rising overall despite dips

original_instantiations: the index is said not to keep increasing, yet the overall trend is to rise
the concession comes first

units.source_excerpt: though the level does not keep increasing, the overall trend is to rise up
units.reusable_pattern: concede the dips before stating the trend
prohibited_generalizations: do not state a trend the line does not have

units.function: a fit statistic is reported and then excused

original_instantiations: the fit is called not perfect and the excuse is the randomness of climate
the model is still said to show something vital

units.source_excerpt: the goodness of fit is not perfect, because climate is random complexity, however the model still elaborates a vital phenomenon
units.reusable_pattern: report a weak fit and excuse it
prohibited_generalizations: do not hide a weak fit

units.rhetorical_move: defines the tipping point by a rank boundary
units.function: a threshold is taken from a classification boundary

original_instantiations: dropping to the stated value is said to put a country into the fragile rank
the value comes from the earlier clustering

units.source_excerpt: we can fairly know that when a country's index drops down to the stated value, it enters the fragile rank
units.reusable_pattern: take a tipping point from a classification boundary
prohibited_generalizations: do not invent a boundary the clustering did not give

units.rhetorical_move: widens the warning to every aspect
units.function: one threshold is said to be not enough

original_instantiations: a single index is said to be the wrong place for the critical point, so each aspect gets its own
the obligation is ought not

units.source_excerpt: a country's critical point ought not to be just one index, for one hazardous aspect may not show in the combined index
units.reusable_pattern: refuse a single threshold and give each part its own
prohibited_generalizations: do not multiply thresholds without a reason

units.rhetorical_move: tells the reader to keep vigilant
units.function: a threshold is delivered as a warning

original_instantiations: reaching the listed levels is said to call for vigilance because the influence has gone high
the country is said to slide to the fragile rank

units.source_excerpt: when the parameters reach the level in the table, the country should keep vigilant, for the influence already goes to a high level and the country would slide to the fragile rank
units.reusable_pattern: deliver a threshold as a warning to stay watchful
prohibited_generalizations: do not warn beyond the stated levels

units.function: a forecast is phrased as a sudden rise

original_instantiations: the index is said to boom and pass the stated line by a named year
the verb carries the drama

units.source_excerpt: by the stated year the index will boom and exceed the stated value, which represents that it falls into a fragile country
units.reusable_pattern: report a forecast with a dramatic verb
prohibited_generalizations: do not dramatize a smooth projection

units.function: a mechanism is labeled as a system type

original_instantiations: stability is said to raise resistance to climate risk, and this is called a positive feedback system
the label follows the mechanism

units.source_excerpt: if a country is stable or impregnable, it raises the resistance to climate risk, and this is a positive feedback system
units.reusable_pattern: label a mechanism as a named system
prohibited_generalizations: do not use a system label the mechanism does not earn

units.function: an extension is offered with its cost

original_instantiations: the model is said to work at other scales, while its precision will fall
the concession is in the same sentence

units.source_excerpt: our coupling model can also work for smaller or larger states, while the precision of our prediction will decrease
units.reusable_pattern: offer an extension together with what it costs
prohibited_generalizations: do not extend a model without naming the cost

units.function: a test result is stated at its strongest

original_instantiations: the sensitivity results are said to show the model has perfect stability
the superlative is not hedged

units.source_excerpt: the results of the sensitivity analysis explain that our model shows a perfect stability
units.reusable_pattern: state a test result at its strongest
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim perfection from one test

units.function: a disagreement between methods is given a size and accepted

original_instantiations: two methods disagree by a few years and the gap is called acceptable
the bound is stated as a range

units.source_excerpt: compared with the earlier result, the error is about two to four years, which is within acceptable limits
units.reusable_pattern: accept a disagreement by bounding it
prohibited_generalizations: do not call a gap acceptable without a stated limit

units.function: a model is called rigorous because of what it rests on

original_instantiations: the model is said to rest on fragility theory and a named report, and is therefore relatively rigorous
the hedge relatively softens the claim

units.source_excerpt: the coupling model is based on the fragility theory and the research results of the panel, thus it is relatively rigorous
units.reusable_pattern: claim rigor from the sources used
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim rigor from a citation alone

units.rhetorical_move: owns the use of a national average
units.function: a simplification is admitted with its cost

original_instantiations: the country's climate is represented by a national average, and this is said to risk the accuracy
the cost is hedged with may

units.source_excerpt: ignoring the difference of climate across the country, we use the national average, which may reduce the accuracy of our model
units.reusable_pattern: own a simplification and its cost to accuracy
prohibited_generalizations: do not hide an averaging assumption

units.function: an exclusion is admitted as a weakness

original_instantiations: the assumption that every country acts is restated as a weakness, with the passive countries named as left out
the cost is left vague

units.source_excerpt: we argue that all the countries react positively, neglecting the passive countries, which may exert on our cost model
units.reusable_pattern: restate an assumption as a weakness
prohibited_generalizations: do not leave the cost of an exclusion unstated

units.function: the paper ends on strengths and weaknesses rather than a summary

original_instantiations: the final section weighs the model and does not restate the results
there is no separate closing section

units.source_excerpt: the paper closes by weighing the model rather than restating the results
units.reusable_pattern: end on an evaluation instead of a restatement
prohibited_generalizations: do not invent a closing summary the paper lacks

units.rhetorical_move: mixes a synthesis report, a journal article and a data page
units.function: the source list runs from reports to data

original_instantiations: the list holds an assessment report, journal articles, a working paper and data pages
each entry is numbered

units.source_excerpt: the sources run from an assessment report and journal articles to data pages
units.reusable_pattern: let the reference list show the range of source types
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat a data page as a finding
